<json>{
  "states": [
    "ConnectionSetup",
    "TokenUploadPending",
    "AwaitingBrokerChallenge",
    "AwaitingClientResponse",
    "Authenticated",
    "Unauthorized"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ConnectionSetup",
      "event": "receive CONNECT with token only",
      "action": "send AUTH 0x18 with RS nonce",
      "to": "AwaitingClientResponse"
    },
    {
      "from": "ConnectionSetup",
      "event": "receive CONNECT with invalid token",
      "action": "reply CONNACK 0x87",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "ConnectionSetup",
      "event": "receive CONNECT with PoP TLS exporter",
      "action": "validate token and signature",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingClientResponse",
      "event": "receive AUTH with Client nonce and signature",
      "action": "validate signature and token",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingClientResponse",
      "event": "cond invalid signature or token",
      "action": "reply CONNACK 0x87",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "send CONNACK 0x00",
      "action": "set Session Present flag",
      "to": "ConnectionSetup"
    },
    {
      "from": "TokenUploadPending",
      "event": "receive PUBLISH to authz-info",
      "action": "store token in key store",
      "to": "ConnectionSetup"
    },
    {
      "from": "TokenUploadPending",
      "event": "cond invalid token payload",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT 0x99",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "BrokerReceivingPublish",
    "BrokerForwardingPublish",
    "BrokerReceivingSubscribe"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "BrokerReceivingPublish",
      "event": "receive PUBLISH QoS >= 1",
      "action": "send PUBACK or PUBREC 0x87",
      "to": "BrokerReceivingPublish"
    },
    {
      "from": "BrokerReceivingPublish",
      "event": "receive PUBLISH QoS 0",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT 0x87",
      "to": "BrokerReceivingPublish"
    },
    {
      "from": "BrokerReceivingPublish",
      "event": "cond unauthorized hide topic",
      "action": "send error 0x80",
      "to": "BrokerReceivingPublish"
    },
    {
      "from": "BrokerForwardingPublish",
      "event": "cond subscriber unauthorized",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT 0x87",
      "to": "BrokerForwardingPublish"
    },
    {
      "from": "BrokerReceivingSubscribe",
      "event": "receive SUBSCRIBE unauthorized",
      "action": "send SUBACK 0x87",
      "to": "BrokerReceivingSubscribe"
    },
    {
      "from": "BrokerReceivingSubscribe",
      "event": "cond unauthorized hide topic",
      "action": "send SUBACK 0x80",
      "to": "BrokerReceivingSubscribe"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "Authenticated",
    "TokenExpired",
    "Reauthenticating",
    "Disconnected"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "cond token_expired",
      "action": "send PUBACK SUBACK DISCONNECT NotAuthorized",
      "to": "TokenExpired"
    },
    {
      "from": "TokenExpired",
      "event": "receive AUTH Reauthentication",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT NotAuthorized",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive AUTH Reauthentication",
      "action": "set token_updated",
      "to": "Reauthenticating"
    },
    {
      "from": "Reauthenticating",
      "event": "cond reauth_failed",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT NotAuthorized",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "Disconnected",
    "Connecting",
    "Connected",
    "Publishing",
    "Subscribing"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Disconnected",
      "event": "receive CONNECT without token",
      "action": "disconnect client",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Disconnected",
      "event": "receive CONNECT with invalid token",
      "action": "disconnect client",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Disconnected",
      "event": "receive CONNECT with valid token",
      "action": "send CONNACK",
      "to": "Connected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Connected",
      "event": "receive PUBLISH unauthorized",
      "action": "disconnect client",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Connected",
      "event": "receive SUBSCRIBE unauthorized",
      "action": "send SUBACK 0x80",
      "to": "Subscribing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Connected",
      "event": "cond token expired during publish",
      "action": "disconnect client",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    }
  ]
}</json>
